evidence: News flow leading into May 13, 2022 is heavily dominated by the systemic contagion from the Terra/UST collapse, triggering massive market-wide liquidations exceeding $1.28B and pushing Bitcoin down toward $26,000. On-chain metrics reported in the news show transfers to exchanges spiking near all-time highs, indicating intense panic and potential continuing sell pressure over the immediate 24-hour horizon. While modest positive structural items emerged—such as Germany clarifying tax-free treatment for crypto held over one year and a Shanghai court affirming Bitcoin property rights—these are outweighed by macro panic and liquidation cascades.
limitations: Severe ongoing market volatility driven by algorithmic stablecoin contagion may cause sudden sharp rebounds or accelerated sell-offs that diverge from standard news sentiment lag.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
